name: Winged Temple of Orazca
description: Ritual district of Orazca whose golden facade melted in the battle between Etali and Zacama.

timeline.summary: Huatli waits atop the Winged Temple while Orazca burns and Ixalan is wreathed in fire.
timeline.quote: Huatli, alone, stood atop the Winged Temple of Orazca

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Inti, Mavren and the company hold the temple gate as Huatli climbs three hundred steps to the recitation chamber.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: A flood of Phyrexians climbs the temple's steps toward the line.
timeline.quote: In ones and twos, they started up the lowest steps of the temple

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli recites to the hurricane and the powers of Ixalan, asking them to stand against the end.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Etali's storm falters and the company's line holds against the Phyrexians.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Zetalpa, elder of dawn, pierces Etali's hurricane and slams into him, banishing the night.
timeline.quote: the titanic silhouette of Zetalpa, the elder of dawn, pierced Etali's hurricane

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli finds Inti wounded and Mavren having carried him from the line.
timeline.quote: A blood-slick and oil-stained Mavren limped toward Huatli, dragging a wounded Inti with him.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Zacama, the last and greatest elder, arrives and her roar disintegrates the Phyrexian front ranks.
timeline.quote: Zacama, the final and greatest of the elders, loomed up from the shadows

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Zacama kills the turned Etali by tearing off his head.
timeline.quote: Zacama tore his head from his body, then flung it into the city below.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.
